transcript: Ever wondered how to make crumble cookies from scratch? Well today I'm going to show you the base cookie recipe to make any flavor. Let's get started! Start by creaming together your softened butter, brown sugar and white sugar on high speed for about three minutes until it's really pale and fluffy like this. Then add in your eggs, vanilla, cornstarch, baking powder and salt and mix until everything is smooth and fully combined. Now add in your flour and mix just until you don't see any dry flour left and this is your base dough. Today I split mine into four to do a pink almond sugar cookie with an almond base, a cheesecake one with a graham cracker base, a biscoff one with ground biscoff cookies and a copycat cookies and cream with a black cocoa Oreo cookie base. Scoop and pan all your cookies they all bake at the same time which makes this so easy and while those are in the oven you can prep your topping. I did a mix of cream cheese frosting and American buttercream. Once they were cooled it was time to decorate and I tried to do my best to replicate the crumble flavors I was making and I feel like I did a pretty good job here and that's how I make crumble cookies at home. They look so legit right? Follow me for more unique dessert recipes. Now let's give them a try. I'm really excited to try this biscoff one. Doesn't it look so good? Now our knockoff cookies and cream flavor. The cheesecake cookie looks so cute. I actually really taste the graham cracker in there and last but not least pink sugar cookie. Hmm can't go wrong with the classics.
